text: {"name":"ll_conn_event_timeout","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Handles a BLE connection-event timer expiry, clears timer state, advances past elapsed event times, and recalculates the receive window when applicable.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"timer_ctx","v2":"conn_idx","v3":"timer_flags","v6":"conn_ctx","v7":"event_time","i":"elapsed_event_count","v9":"time_since_anchor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Timer/event flags; bit 3 is cleared and bits 5–6 select receive-window rescheduling."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Event interval added when advancing the scheduled event time."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"64-bit scheduled event time."},{"offset":47,"meaning":"Connection-table index."},{"offset":52,"meaning":"Timer-related substructure passed to the timeout cleanup helper."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Connection-context flags; bit 0x100 is cleared."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"64-bit connection anchor time used when advancing past elapsed events."}]}
